notes: Stages follow the source order. `start` is the first source occurrence of a stage or substage; `verse` splits that occurrence. See docs/chronology.md.

stages.title: البدايات: الخلق والطوفان
stages.reason: Genesis 1 to Genesis 11:26 (with the 1 Chronicles 1 genealogies the source interleaves).

stages.title: الآباء: من إبراهيم إلى يوسف
stages.reason: Genesis 11:27 opens the account of Terah and Abram. Job stays here, where the source places it (groups 19-31), after Genesis 50.

stages.title: الخروج من مصر والعهد
stages.reason: Exodus 1 through Sinai: Exodus, Leviticus and Numbers 1-9, including both source occurrences of Numbers 7-9.

stages.title: البرية والاستعداد لأرض الموعد
stages.reason: Numbers 10 (the source group in which Israel leaves Sinai) through Deuteronomy 34 and Psalm 90.

stages.title: أرض الموعد وعصر القضاة
stages.reason: Joshua 1 through Judges, Ruth and 1 Samuel 1-7 (Samuel, the last judge).

stages.title: المملكة المتحدة: شاول وداود وسليمان
stages.reason: 1 Samuel 8, where Israel asks for a king, through Solomon's death and Ecclesiastes, which the source places after 1 Kings 11.

stages.title: المملكة المنقسمة وخدمة الأنبياء
stages.reason: 1 Kings 12, the division of the kingdom, through the siege of Jerusalem, with the prophets where the source interleaves them.

stages.title: السبي والرجاء
stages.reason: 2 Kings 25:3, the fall of Jerusalem, through Daniel 9.

stages.title: العودة وتجديد العهد
stages.reason: 2 Chronicles 36:22-23 and Ezra 1, Cyrus's decree, through Nehemiah, Malachi and Joel, which the source places last.

stages.title: حياة يسوع وخدمته
stages.reason: The four Gospels, harmonized by the source, through the ascension.

substages.title: الميلاد والبداية
substages.reason: Prologues, birth, childhood, John the Baptist, baptism and temptation, first disciples and the beginning of signs (John 2-4).

substages.title: الخدمة
substages.reason: Mark 1:14-15: after John's arrest Jesus begins preaching in Galilee; through the Olivet discourse.

substages.title: الصلب والقيامة
substages.reason: Mark 14:1, the plot to kill Jesus and the Passover, through the resurrection appearances and the ascension.

stages.title: رحلات بولس التبشيرية
stages.reason: Acts 13-20 with the letters the source interleaves.

substages.title: الرحلة التبشيرية الأولى
substages.reason: Acts 13:1-15:35: the first journey, Galatians and the Jerusalem council.

substages.title: الرحلة التبشيرية الثانية
substages.reason: Acts 15:36 (heading: بولس وبرنابا يفترقان) to 18:22, with 1 and 2 Thessalonians.

substages.title: الرحلة التبشيرية الثالثة
substages.reason: Acts 18:23, Paul sets out through Galatia and Phrygia, to Acts 20:38, with 1 Corinthians, Romans and 2 Corinthians.

stages.title: بولس إلى روما ورسائل السجن
stages.reason: Acts 21-28 with Ephesians, Colossians, Philemon and Philippians.

stages.title: تثبيت الكنائس ورسائل الرسل
stages.reason: James (after Philippians in the source) through Jude.
